result.planSummary: Implemented deterministic chunk lifecycle by adding persisted chunk store operations, validating chunk close settings, and building the chunk service that promotes closed smoothed turns into ordered chunk state while enforcing the one-open-chunk invariant and deterministic soft/hard closure behavior.

changedFiles.reason: Added chunk persistence read/write contracts so async-thread services can manage persisted chunk lifecycle state.
Persisted `chunks.json` for each thread and implemented atomic chunk read/write operations guarded by existing thread mutation checks.
Added deterministic chunk close settings validation used by the chunk lifecycle service.
Implemented chunk eligibility, ordered appends, one-open-chunk enforcement, deterministic soft-threshold closure, hard-max closure, and blocker reporting.
Added Story 2 coverage for all 11 mapped TCs plus the hard-max next-open non-TC regression.
Updated the persisted thread artifact expectation to include the new `chunks.json` file.

findingsFixed: Implemented persisted chunk lifecycle state instead of leaving `updateChunkState` as a stub.
Added deterministic validation and blocker handling for invalid chunk settings or invalid multi-open-chunk state.
Covered all Story 2 chunk lifecycle acceptance conditions plus same-pass hard-max next-open behavior with automated tests.
Updated E2E persisted-file expectations so the new `chunks.json` artifact remains part of the verified thread layout.

result.recommendedNextStep: Hand off to verification, then continue with Story 3 placeholder artifact generation on closed chunks.
